as y from_yaml awkward/awkward.yaml
as j from_json awkward-value/awkward-value.json
equals @y $j
to_yaml @y
as w from_yaml written/written.yaml
equals @y $w
to_yaml @w
as c from_yaml comment/comment.yaml
to_yaml @c
as n from_yaml numbers/numbers.yaml
to_json @n
to_yaml @n

from_yaml tab/tab.yaml
